display_order: The Chamber, Seneca, The Villa, The Summons, The Witnesses, The Bath, The Tablet, The Hand
note: Eight uploaded DLORIAN images. Frame 01 is hero and is not repeated. Gallery 02–08 is server-rendered HTML, not dependent on JavaScript. Original initial Seneca composition preserved in Git history.

frames.title: The Chamber
frames.alt: A dark Roman interior after Seneca’s death, with a bronze basin, white drapery and a distant cold glow.

frames.title: Seneca
frames.alt: An intimate half-lit portrait of an elderly Seneca emerging from a nearly black room.

frames.title: The Villa
frames.alt: A monumental Roman villa at dusk; distant figures approach a broad colonnaded facade.

frames.title: The Summons
frames.alt: Armoured Roman soldiers seen from behind, ascending the steps of a monumental dark entrance.

frames.title: The Witnesses
frames.alt: A luminous reclining figure, attended by shadowed companions in a dark Roman interior.

frames.title: The Bath
frames.alt: A seated Seneca raises one arm from a steaming stone bath in a crimson-lit room.

frames.title: The Tablet
frames.alt: A large Roman-style inscription slab lit by warm embers beside indistinct standing figures.

frames.title: The Hand
frames.alt: An outstretched, bloodied hand above a dark bowl, catching soft golden reflections.
